title: Zhi — trading agents bound by the chain
voice: confident young woman, 20-25, warm but sharp, slightly amused, fast-paced

scenes.visual: title card: black, the 智 seal stamps in, wordmark ZHI
scenes.vo: AI trading agents are fast. Tireless. And one bad prompt away from blowing up your account.

scenes.visual: landing hero, carved seal rotating, cursor types an idea
scenes.vo: Meet Zhi. You describe a strategy in plain words. An AI writes it into rules, once. You sign them. And from that moment, a smart contract on Injective enforces every single limit.

scenes.visual: scroll through How it works: compile, Synth gate, vault panels
scenes.vo: The model plans. Bittensor's Synth network verifies every entry. And the chain enforces. Three layers, and each one trusts nothing above it.

scenes.visual: Playground: click Prompt-injected 20x, Fat-finger, Down 5% today
scenes.vo: So go ahead. Try to break it. Prompt-inject twenty-x leverage? Blocked. Fat-finger nine thousand dollars? Blocked. Lose five percent in a day? The vault freezes itself. And anyone, anywhere, can pull that brake.

scenes.visual: Markets terminal: search TSLA, then BTC, chart, order book, agent panel
scenes.vo: This is the Zhi terminal. Three hundred and fifty live Injective markets. Real charts. The real on-chain order book. Pick a market, go short, set your leverage and your stop, and build.

scenes.visual: Launch page: rule tree preview with provenance flags, hash, deploy panel
scenes.vo: Every rule, in plain English. Green came from you. Amber is a safe default. Red got capped. One signature, and your vault and its on-chain identity go live on Injective.

scenes.visual: Leaderboard, agent page: bounds, evidence feed, poke button
scenes.vo: And this is real. Our agent just checked every bound, and placed its order on Injective, live. Every trade, and every skipped trade, lands on-chain as evidence. That evidence becomes a Zhi Score. And the score unlocks capital.
The model plans. The subnet verifies. The chain enforces. This is Zhi. Build your agent today, on Injective.
